title: 第五章 还阳日
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

城隍领旨办事，见秦勉相中了借尸还魂的人家，便令黑白无常带着她去还阳。

走到土地庙时，先前早已别过的云百里，竟又出现了。

他在黄泉路上接到了金绵，打探出几分生平境况，盯着她喝下孟婆汤后，便紧赶慢赶地过来，告诉秦勉。

而其中，最有用的信息是，金绵十六七岁就随父亲沿运河北上，最远到过燕京一带寻求商机。父母病亡后，如今二十出头的金绵，带着匠人师傅和两个家仆，支撑铺子和家宅，养育唯一的胞妹。

秦勉身边的黑无常，不由笑着揶揄：“百里娃儿，你还真上心。”

云百里光明正大道：“秦娘子对咱出手大方，又被孟婆相中，将来官儿比小弟大，小弟自然要多多巴结。”

言罢，不等秦勉道谢，便拱手转身，流云般飘向忘川，心中却捺不下一个念头：只愿七年后，后土娘娘那儿，再来点啥变数，好教秦勉这样有情有义的一个人，还是莫留在地府做鬼差了。

秦勉以“金绵”的身份，在卧房榻上醒过来时，闻到浓重汤药味。

远近两种声响，也钻入她的耳朵。

遥遥传来的，是连绵不绝的嘈杂之音。

这符合云百里从金绵亡魂口中问来的情形：金家铺子位于应天府最繁华的秦淮河附近。虽非临街的好地段，仍能听到市井的喧沸。

而近在咫尺的，则是软糯细柔的女声：“阿姐，阿姐你醒了吗？”

秦勉睁开眼，看到一个十岁上下的女童，小圆脸凑近她，点墨似的眼眸中，盛满惊喜，白皙的脖子里戴着银项圈，身上的凉衫料子细腻。

不像小丫鬟打扮，那，就应该是与金绵相依为命的小妹，金绣。

“嗯，”秦勉盯着她看，蚊声开口，“阿绣。”

小姑娘开心得跳起来，转身跑到门边大喊：“阿姐活了，柳妈，阿姐活了！”

一个中年妇人冲进来，四旬年纪，双目略凹，五官有些男子的棱角感，但组合在一起，配上展颜微笑的神态，竟露出佛相的慈蔼。

柳妈，原是金绵母亲的丫鬟，陪主人嫁过来后，带大了绵、绣两姐妹，并在金氏夫妇过世后，帮着金绵支撑铺子，算得金家半个话事人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The city god took charge of the matter and saw that Qin Mian had fallen in love with the person who borrowed the corpse to bring the soul back to life, so he ordered Hei Bai Wuchang to take her to return to the sun.

When they reached the Tutu Temple, Yun Baili, who had been gone for a long time, appeared again.

He picked up Jin Mian on Huangquan Road, found out a bit about her life situation, watched her drink Meng Po soup, and then hurried over slowly to tell Qin Mian.

Among them, the most useful information is that Jin Mian followed his father north along the canal when he was sixteen or seventeen, and went as far as Yanjing to seek business opportunities.After her parents died of illness, Jin Mian, now in her early twenties, took a master craftsman and two domestic servants to support the shop and house, and raised her only sister.

Hei Wuchang beside Qin Mian couldn't help but smile and tease: "Baili baby, you are really interested."

Yun Baili Guangming said in an upright manner: "Ms. Qin has been generous to us, and she has been favored by Po Meng. In the future, the official will be older than the younger brother, so the younger brother will naturally have to fawn over her."

After saying that, without waiting for Qin Mian to say thank you, he turned around and floated towards Wangchuan River like flowing clouds, but he couldn't hold back one thought in his heart: I only hope that after seven years, there will be some changes at Houtu Empress' place, so that Qin Mian, a kind and righteous person like Qin Mian, should not stay in the underworld and work as a ghost.

Qin Mian, as "Jin Mian", smelled a strong smell of soup and medicine when he woke up on the couch in his bedroom.

Sounds both far and near also penetrated her ears.

What came from the distance was a continuous noisy sound.

This is in line with what Yun Baili asked from the dead soul of Jin Mian: Jin's shop is located near the Qinhuai River, the most prosperous area in Yingtian Mansion.Although it is not a good location facing the street, you can still hear the bustle of the market.

And what was close at hand was a soft female voice: "Sister, sister, are you awake?"

Qin Mian opened his eyes and saw a girl about ten years old, with a small round face approaching her, eyes full of surprise like ink spots, a silver collar on her fair neck, and a summer sweater of fine material.

She doesn't dress like a little maid, so she should be Jin Xiu, the little girl who depends on Jin Mian for her life.

"Well," Qin Mian stared at her and said, "Axiu."

The little girl jumped up with joy, turned around and ran to the door and shouted: "Sister A is alive, Mother Liu, Sister A is alive!"

A middle-aged woman rushed in. She was in her forties, her eyes were slightly sunken, and her facial features were somewhat angular like a man's. But when combined with her smiling face, she actually revealed the kindness of a Buddha.

Liu Ma was originally the maid of Jin Mian's mother. After marrying with her master, she brought up two sisters, Mian and Xiu. After the Jin couple passed away, she helped Jin Mian support the shop and became half of the Jin family's gossip.
